name: Yuanbao-Reranker (0.6B / 4B / 8B)
vendor: Yuanbao-Search (HF organization; the card names no parent company)

lineage.base_model: Qwen3 backbone (8B card: Qwen/Qwen3-8B; 0.6B and 4B on the Qwen3 line)
lineage.how_derived: trained on 2.75M ranking groups from document-grounded synthesis (answer-first, query-type-guided), three-stage curation, difficulty-stratified negatives; bounded minimum-gap preference distillation plus layerwise adaptive LERP merging (card)

purpose: Pointwise yes/no reranker that scores query-document relevance in [0,1] across Chinese, multilingual, English, long-document (up to 8,192 tokens) and code retrieval (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card header and badge say Apache-2.0 for the 8B; HF metadata of 0.6B also says apache-2.0; no LICENSE file opened.

architecture.kind: dense decoder reranker on Qwen3 (relevance probability from yes/no tokens)
architecture.why_this_design: Card: preference distillation optimizes pointwise yes/no cross-entropy together with a capped pairwise hinge over positive-negative and negative-negative pairs; layerwise merging adds no inference overhead.

engine_support.notes: Same Qwen3 reranker prompt style as Qwen3-Reranker (yes/no token scoring), which llama.cpp supports for that family; for this checkpoint not tested.

benchmarks.name: Five-panel average nDCG@10 (CMTEB-R, MMTEB-R, BEIR, MLDR, MTEB-Code) on a Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B top-100 pool
benchmarks.harness: card, shared candidate pool of top-100 from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B

strengths: Beats Qwen3-Reranker-8B on every panel per the card (+1.53 average)
0.6B at 70.96 average is a small option
Code retrieval and long documents (8,192 tokens) in the evaluation
weaknesses: Builder's own evaluation with its own candidate pool; no independent run
Little adoption (74 downloads for the 8B on the HF API)
best_for: second-stage reranking for RAG and code search

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 reranker family on a Qwen3 backbone that Tona's reranker path (qwen3-reranker record) would carry; the gain over Qwen3-Reranker is small and vendor-measured, and adoption is nil so far.
